services.desc: Industry discounts: complimentary tasting of 5 wines and 10% off bottles of wine, for those who work at another winery, not bars or restaurants. Reserve Wine Pass: 2 for 1 tasting. Pay for a tasting of your preferred 5 wines and get a complimentary tasting! Guests will hear about the Zissios’ family history of three generations of winemaking. As one of the few family owned and operated wineries in Virginia, our tour is truly an amazing experience. blurb: Guests can enjoy walking tours of the vineyard, winemaker-led tastings, exclusive limited-release wine flights, and seasonal food pairings. The vineyard offers picturesque views of the Blue Ridge Mountains and hosts events such as weddings, corporate retreats, and private parties. Activities include grape-stomping sessions during the fall harvest season.
